sources.title: Bluetooth Technology Overview
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Bluetooth Mesh Managed Flooding：重播與中繼成本
related.titleEn: Bluetooth Mesh managed flooding: relay and repeat costs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 6.4 ms payload-only 與 1.6 ms payload-only，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 6.4 ms payload-only and 1.6 ms payload-only, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋3.5 ms aggregate airtime與5.5 ms aggregate airtime，建立mesh_relays.csv、去重鍵、TTL逐跳紀錄，並完成以下驗收：4 ms合計空中預算只3中繼例通過；若因TTL未到目標則不能以省時算成功。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 3.5 ms aggregate airtime and 5.5 ms aggregate airtime; create mesh_relays.csv, deduplication keys and per-hop TTL trace; apply this acceptance decision: Only3 relays meet a4 ms aggregate airtime budget; failure to reach the target within TTL is not success through lower cost.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 LE Coded不同編碼配置交換資料率與接收條件；payload位元/資料率僅是空中時間的一部分。 展開基準式 800/125000*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用每ms125與500 bit反算800；實際PDU時間須再依封包不同區段使用正確速率。 將兩條推導一起存入 coded_phy_airtime.csv、PDU分段表、能力比對。
從原理 受控泛洪以中繼、重複抑制與TTL限制擴散；傳輸次數不是唯一節點數，去重仍不可省。 展開基準式 (1+3*2)*0.5；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用message_id、relay_id、repeat_index枚舉7與11次；確認接收應用只交付一次。 將兩條推導一起存入 mesh_relays.csv、去重鍵、TTL逐跳紀錄。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from LE Coded configurations trade data rate against reception conditions; payload bits divided by data rate is only part of airtime., expand baseline expression 800/125000*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Recover800 bits from125/500 bits per millisecond; real PDU time requires the proper rate for each packet section. Save both derivations with coded_phy_airtime.csv, PDU section table and capability comparison.

Starting from Managed flooding uses relays, duplicate suppression and TTL; transmission count differs from unique-node count and deduplication remains necessary., expand baseline expression (1+3*2)*0.5; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Enumerate7/11 transmissions by message_id, relay_id and repeat_index; confirm one application delivery. Save both derivations with mesh_relays.csv, deduplication keys and per-hop TTL trace.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Iridium Crosslinks：衛星中繼跳數與路徑餘裕
related.titleEn: Iridium crosslinks: satellite hops and path margin
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 6.4 ms payload-only 與 1.6 ms payload-only，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 6.4 ms payload-only and 1.6 ms payload-only, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋21.5 ms與35.8333333333 ms，建立iridium_hops.csv、鄰接快照、距離與處理分帳，並完成以下驗收：30 ms星間預算只3hop例通過；真實網路路由與可用性不能由此合成圖推定。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 21.5 ms and 35.8333333333 ms; create iridium_hops.csv, adjacency snapshot and propagation/processing ledger; apply this acceptance decision: Only3 hops meet a30 ms intersatellite budget; the synthetic graph establishes no real routing or availability claim.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 LE Coded不同編碼配置交換資料率與接收條件；payload位元/資料率僅是空中時間的一部分。 展開基準式 800/125000*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：用每ms125與500 bit反算800；實際PDU時間須再依封包不同區段使用正確速率。 將兩條推導一起存入 coded_phy_airtime.csv、PDU分段表、能力比對。
從原理 星間路由把總距離與逐跳處理相加；hop數相同也可能有不同幾何與時間。 展開基準式 3*(2000/300000*1000+0.5)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列每hop長度與處理後累加，再以總距離/c交叉驗；記錄接入段尚未計入。 將兩條推導一起存入 iridium_hops.csv、鄰接快照、距離與處理分帳。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from LE Coded configurations trade data rate against reception conditions; payload bits divided by data rate is only part of airtime., expand baseline expression 800/125000*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Recover800 bits from125/500 bits per millisecond; real PDU time requires the proper rate for each packet section. Save both derivations with coded_phy_airtime.csv, PDU section table and capability comparison.

Starting from Inter-satellite paths sum propagation distance and per-hop processing; equal hop count does not guarantee equal geometry or delay., expand baseline expression 3*(2000/300000*1000+0.5); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Sum per-hop distance and processing, then cross-check total distance/c; mark ground access as excluded. Save both derivations with iridium_hops.csv, adjacency snapshot and propagation/processing ledger.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
